title: Prove durable launch admission through the typed attempt owner

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage

**Verdict.** Caught. The maintained distinct-story case catches refusal of an independent owner's request when a different story already has a pending attempt.

**Story and revision.** `SEED-413#renovate-later-dashboard-backend-unit-test-families` at `e185acefc33e5f9decaf939c6b129cd7d2f31298`. The story promises that overlapping requests for different stories are both kept and can run.

**Fault and independent observation.** In the detached checkout, `sameStory` at `dashboard/server/launchAttemptConflicts.ts:37` treated any defined story from the same project as a match. The maintained spec and fixtures stayed byte-for-byte intact. A separate witness submitted a MakeMe execution request for `SEED-001#first` and a refinement request for `SEED-002#second` to independent owners sharing one disposable home. It recorded that execution was accepted and started one callback. Refinement returned `already-starting` with zero callbacks. The real attempt file kept only `SEED-001#first`. The maintained assertion at `dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-cross-server-accept.spec.ts:244` caught `['failed', 0]` where it required `['accepted', 1]` for each owner.

**Runs and restoration.** The maintained backend runner selected only `admits both starts for distinct stories` using `--grep` on `launches/agent-launch-cross-server-accept\.spec\.ts$` with two workers. Baseline passed, the faulted run failed at the named assertion, and the restored run passed. The restored source matched its original bytes, and the checkout status and revision matched the baseline. The scratch checkout was removed. Runner records, the sole fault diff, and the separate observation remain in `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-413.6k9xhd`.

**Next proof action.** Keep the per-owner acceptance and callback assertion and the persisted identity check.

- **Test runtime.** 6.59 seconds (measured), summed from the three Vitest duration lines. Baseline 3.21 seconds, fault 1.48 seconds, restored 1.90 seconds. The maintained commands took 9.62 seconds in total by `/usr/bin/time -p`.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. The check recorded no separate human-effort measure.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The check recorded no measure separating agent activity from tool and test waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 116737 ms (measured), from 1795562431422 to 1795562548159 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: e185acefc33e5f9decaf939c6b129cd7d2f31298, Caught. Keep the existing acceptance, callback and persisted identity assertions. No follow-up.
